name: Avondale House
about:
Welcome to Avondale House: Boutique Student Living. This stunning 1925 colonial has character and charm for days. Lease a room and only be responsible for your rent! 
Schedule your tour today!
*Utilities included until July 2025.
*Shared bedrooms available for a $100/month premium.
Availability: 
January 1st - 
Room 202 - $750/month - Medium Bedroom/Shared Bathroom
Room 206 - $750/month - Medium Bedroom/Shared Bathroom
March 1st - 103 - $799/month - Small Bedroom/ Private Bathroom
April 1st - 102 - $799/month - Small Bedroom/Privarte En Suite Bathroom
All leases end July 31, 2025 or July 31, 2026. 
Please note that we are not pet friendly.
Rental Criteria - Must make 3 times the rent or use a guarantor. No prior evictions. Criminal background check. 
Application fee is $50/applicant. Deposit and 1 full month's rent due prior to move in. 
1 block to downtown Avondale: restaurants, bars, Avondale Park and Library. 
2 miles to UAB. 
4.5 miles to Samford.
6 miles to Birmingham Southern. 
10 miles to Miles College.
Applications available now at www.jnspropertiesandmangement.com
